approvals.note: Approved under "we need to make sure this change works for multiple sessions.. when they are archived.. they start a new change it should show the new change stages" (Grok chat on 2026-11-21, relayed by grok-build); covered scope: an open session sets the stage label, and an archived story sets it only when no open session remains; limits: this behavior only, do not merge, do not edit archived records, do not close the keep-label review. Recorded by grok-build (Grok 4.7, hc t10j).

approved_scope.title: An open session sets the stage label when archived sessions are also on the pull request
approved_scope.description: An open session sets the stage label when archived sessions are also on the pull request
acceptance_criteria: A pull request that introduces an archived session at done and an open session at intent is labeled chough-stage:intent, and the done label is removed. A pull request whose only introduced session is an archived story at done is labeled chough-stage:done. Two open sessions at different stages still get no stage label. The two script copies stay byte-identical.

answers.constraints: tasks.md has no unchecked boxes. The two script copies stay byte-identical. The delta is frozen once approved. Do not edit the approved keep-label change or archived records. Do not merge.
